On The 8 th Of March, 2025

 Pallavi Singh D/O Pushpraj Singh
 Versus
 The State Of M.P And Others
 Appearance:
 Parties through their counsel.
 Order

Applicant has filed this Criminal Revision being aggrieved of the order dated 23-07-2021 passed in ST No. 89/2019 by learned 3rd Additional Sessions Judge, Singrauli whereby charges have been framed against the applicant under Sections 376, 406, 417, 420, 495 and 506/34 of IPC.

It is pointed out that during the pendency of the present revision petition, ST No. 89/2019 has finally been decided on 14-10-2022 by the learned trial Court, wherein the applicant has been acquitted.
Therefore, nothing survives for adjudication in the present revision petition.
Accordingly, this Criminal Revision is disposed of having rendered infructuous.
